description: Paremoremo is a sprawling rural-fringe suburb on the upper harbour of Auckland's North Shore. Known for its lifestyle blocks and green spaces, it is one of the largest suburbs by land area on the Shore.

Albany is the commercial heart of Auckland's North Shore, home to Westfield Albany, Massey University, and North Harbour Stadium. It is one of Auckland's fastest-growing suburbs with a mix of residential and commercial developments.
Greenhithe is a large, leafy North Shore suburb that bridges the gap between the established Shore and West Auckland. Known for its village feel, large sections, and family-friendly environment.

Long Bay sits at the northeastern tip of the North Shore, dominated by the beautiful Long Bay Regional Park. The suburb has expanded significantly with new housing developments while retaining large recreational areas.
Torbay is the largest residential suburb in the northern East Coast Bays, covering a wide hilly area ending at Waiake Beach. It is a popular family suburb with excellent schools and coastal access.

Browns Bay is the undisputed commercial hub of the East Coast Bays on Auckland's North Shore. With its beachfront shopping village, cafes, and busy town centre, it serves as the central anchor for the entire eastern coastline.
Glenfield is the central powerhouse of the North Shore, sitting at the geographic middle and connecting east, west, and south. Home to Glenfield Mall and well-established residential neighbourhoods.

Beach Haven is the largest suburb in the southwestern Kaipatiki area of the North Shore. Covering a broad peninsula jutting into the Waitemata Harbour, it offers a mix of established homes and harbour views.

Takapuna is the commercial metro centre of Auckland's North Shore. With its stunning beach, bustling retail precinct, and high-density living, it connects the Shore to the rest of Auckland via the Harbour Bridge.

Devonport covers the entire southern headland of the North Shore, directly facing Auckland's CBD across the harbour. This historic village suburb is known for its character homes, naval base, and iconic volcanic cones.
Milford is a popular North Shore suburb situated between Takapuna and the East Coast Bays. Known for its beach, shopping centre, and established residential streets.
Birkenhead is a harbourside suburb on the North Shore with a strong community feel, local shops, and excellent harbour access. It is well-connected to the CBD via bus and ferry.
Northcote is a centrally located North Shore suburb undergoing significant urban development. Well-positioned between Takapuna and Glenfield with easy motorway access.
Sunnynook is a well-connected North Shore suburb sitting between Albany and Takapuna along the Northern Busway. Popular with families for its schools, parks, and easy transport links.
Mairangi Bay is a sought-after coastal suburb in the East Coast Bays. Known for its sandy beach, family-friendly parks, and proximity to Browns Bay's shopping and dining.
Mt Eden is one of Auckland's most popular central suburbs, named after the volcanic cone Maungawhau. Known for its village atmosphere, heritage villas, and excellent schools.
Ponsonby is Auckland's iconic inner-city suburb known for its vibrant dining scene, boutique shopping, and beautifully restored character homes along Ponsonby Road.
Grey Lynn is a trendy inner-city Auckland suburb popular with young professionals and families. Known for its heritage villas, leafy streets, and proximity to Ponsonby and the city centre.
Remuera is one of Auckland's most established and affluent suburbs, known for its large homes, prestigious schools, and tree-lined streets close to the CBD.
Parnell is Auckland's oldest suburb, featuring a charming village of boutiques, galleries, and cafes. Close to the Domain and CBD with a mix of heritage and modern apartments.
Newmarket is Auckland's premier shopping district with a mix of retail, dining, and residential living. Well-connected by rail and bus to the wider Auckland region.
Epsom is a well-established central Auckland suburb prized for its sought-after school zones, leafy streets, and character homes. Centrally located with easy access to all parts of Auckland.

Auckland's central business district is the commercial heart of the city, with a mix of high-rise apartments, office buildings, and hospitality venues. KA Plumbing services both residential and commercial properties in the CBD.
Grafton is a small inner-city suburb adjacent to the Auckland Domain and Hospital. A mix of heritage homes and modern apartments, well-connected to the CBD and university precinct.
Herne Bay is a premium harbourside Auckland suburb known for its waterfront properties, village shops, and stunning views across the Waitemata Harbour.
Westmere is a quiet residential suburb nestled between Ponsonby and Grey Lynn, offering harbour views, village charm, and family-friendly streets close to the city centre.
Mt Albert is a diverse and well-connected West Auckland suburb with a village shopping centre, good transport links, and a mix of housing from villas to modern townhouses.
Avondale is a growing West Auckland suburb with a vibrant Sunday market, new developments, and great transport connections via train and bus.
Henderson is the main commercial centre of West Auckland, featuring WestCity Waitakere shopping centre, the Corban Estate Arts Centre, and a mix of suburban and rural-fringe living.
New Lynn is a busy West Auckland suburb centred around LynnMall shopping centre and the train station. A growing residential hub with good access to the motorway network.
Titirangi is a leafy, artistic suburb nestled in the Waitakere Ranges on Auckland's western edge. Known for its native bush, creative community, and village atmosphere.
Glen Eden is a family-friendly West Auckland suburb with a local shopping centre, train station, and easy access to the Waitakere Ranges for outdoor recreation.
Te Atatu is a peninsula suburb in West Auckland surrounded by the Waitemata Harbour. Known for its community spirit, waterfront walkways, and convenient motorway access.
Blockhouse Bay is a residential suburb in West Auckland with harbour views, local shops, and a mix of established and new housing. Well-positioned between the city and West Auckland.
Onehunga is a diverse South Auckland suburb with a strong retail precinct, Dress Smart outlet shopping, and waterfront access along the Manukau Harbour.
Royal Oak is a central-south Auckland suburb known for its roundabout, local shopping strip, and proximity to One Tree Hill and Cornwall Park.
Mt Roskill is one of Auckland's most populated suburbs, offering diverse communities, local shopping, and great access to motorways connecting all parts of Auckland.
Sandringham is a central Auckland suburb known for its multicultural dining scene along Sandringham Road and its proximity to both the city centre and western suburbs.
Kingsland is a vibrant inner-city suburb next to Eden Park, known for its lively bar and dining scene, train station, and mix of character homes and modern apartments.
Morningside is a compact inner-city Auckland suburb between Kingsland and Mt Albert, offering good transport links via the Western Line train and proximity to the city centre.
